scope: Pure literal PostgreSQL18 SELECT comparison only; no message or other user rows read; no writes
sql: SELECT 'Literal 100%_! offer and καφές' ILIKE '%100!%!_!!%' ESCAPE '!' AS literal_match, 'καφές' ILIKE '%ΚΑΦΈΣ%' AS old_greek_match, UPPER('καφές') LIKE UPPER('%ΚΑΦΈΣ%') ESCAPE '!' AS upper_greek_match, UPPER('Καφέσ') LIKE UPPER('%καφές%') ESCAPE '!' AS sigma_match, UPPER('Literal 100%_! offer and καφές') LIKE UPPER('%100!%!_!!%') ESCAPE '!' AS upper_literal_match
